headings.text: The Coca‑Cola® Official Site for Drinks & Experiences
YOU COULD WIN BIG THIS SEASON
Don't Miss the Coca‑Cola Holiday Caravan
A Full Year of Favorites Could Be Yours
Refresh Your Fandom All Year Long

body: Enter every Friday for your chance to win tickets, Fanatics digital gift cards, and more football prizes for fans.
Whether you're a lifelong fan or experiencing the magic for the first time, the Caravan is where holiday traditions come to life.
Enter today for a chance to win 24 (or equivalent) of your favorite Coca‑Cola drinks a month for an entire year. From vitaminwater to Sprite, and so much more, a year supply could be yours.

Soccer Central is your always-on home for the beautiful game. Whether you're into MLS, U.S. Soccer, or English Premier League, we keep soccer fans fueled with exclusive content, prizes, and experiences.
Make the season merry with easy holiday recipes made with Simply®, from cranberry meatballs and glazed ham to festive sangria and warm winter drinks.
Have you downloaded yet? The +one app brings the universe of Coca‑Cola® into the palm of your hand. Start earning rewards today!
We’ve devised a quick, fun way to discover your ideal flavor pairings. Simply stick out your tongue and let us do the mapping. It's not science, but the results might surprise you.
Unlock unlimited visits to World of Coca‑Cola with an Annual Pass. Enjoy exclusive experiences, more moments to explore, and surprises waiting every time you return.
